"''I find the so-called "Mad" Captain Silvo guilty!|Snobbius Snee and Brutus|audio=Snee-Brutus-SC6.flac|{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}}}} '''Snobbius Snee''' was a [[Keteerian]] [[pirate]] in the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] of [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] who took part in [[Silvo's pirate raid|boarding]] a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|merchant freighter]] around [[9 ABY]]. When the [[freighter]]'s vault proved empty, the crew mutinied against Silvo, taking him [[prisoner]] and making the [[Shistavanen]] [[Brutus]] the new captain. After Silvo escaped and was re-captured, he was put on [[Trial of Silvo|trial]] on Brutus's [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]], where Snee announced that Brutus would deliver the verdict. Although the Shistavanen [[Death penalty|sentenced]] the former captain to [[death]], Silvo convinced the crew to travel to the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] in search of an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[At Attin Mint|mint]] during his [[Right of Last Appeal]] and so was spared. At At Attin, Silvo killed Brutus and took command of the pirates again, gaining them entry through the [[Barrier]] that surrounded the world. During the pirates' subsequent [[Invasion of At Attin|invasion]] of the planet, Snee remained beside the pirate [[Gunter]] while he sat in the captain's chair on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[frigate]]. After the residents of At Attin sent a [[distress signal]], a [[squadron]] of [[New Republic]] [[starfighter]]s arrived and shot down the frigate, with Snee fleeing from the [[Starship|ship's]] bridge as it crashed. ==Biography== ===Boarding action=== [[File:SnobbiusSneeRaid-SC1.png|thumb|right|300px|Snee took part in raiding a merchant vessel.]] Snobbius Snee was a [[Keteerian]] [[pirate]] who served in the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] of [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]. During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]] around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} they took part in a [[Silvo's pirate raid|boarding action]] against a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|merchant freighter]]. Snee boarded the [[Bulk freighter|freighter]] through a drill-tipped [[Docking tube|boarding tube]] and attacked the [[merchant]] crew, throwing one opponent to the ground and then slashing them with a [[machete]]. When the pirates discovered the [[freighter]]'s vault to be empty, they mutinied against Silvo, having suffered several lean [[cycle]]s and taken casualties in the attack. Silvo was taken [[prisoner]] and held in the [[brig]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] but [[Mission to At Attin|escaped]].{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} ===The Rite of Last Appeal=== {{Quote|The Right of Last Appeal must be honored. Equal time.|Snobbius Snee|audio=Snee-LastAppeal-SC6.flac|}} [[File:Snee-Brutus-SC6.png|thumb|left|300px|Snee delivered announcements for Captain Brutus.]] After Silvo was re-captured on the [[planet]]{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} [[Lanupa]], the former captain was brought for [[Trial of Silvo|trial]] on board the [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]] of the pirates' new captain, the [[Shistavanen]] [[Brutus]]. With the other pirates gathered to watch, Snee announced from beside Brutus that the new captain would deliver his verdict, with the Shistavanen declaring Silvo guilty and [[Death penalty|sentencing]] him to [[death]]. After the pirate [[Chaelt]] interrupted to remind Brutus that Silvo was owed the [[Right of Last Appeal]] under the [[Pirate's Code]], the Shistavanen growled at Snee, who announced that the right would be honored and Silvo would be granted equal [[time]] to defend himself. Silvo then spoke of the pirates' shared hunger for wealth after a lifetime of fighting over scraps, promising them that he could provide them the means to generate their own wealth. Revealing an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]], he claimed to have learned of an [[At Attin Mint|Old Republic Mint]] on the planet [[At Attin]], having heard its location from the legendary pirate [[Tak Rennod]]. [[File:Snee-Silvo-SC6.png|thumb|right|300px|Snee watched the trial of Silvo.]] Although Brutus pointed out that Rennod was dead, Silvo sang a [[Unidentified pirate shanty|shanty]] about Rennod and At Attin with the crew and received a cheer when he asked them to follow him to the treasure. With Silvo's equal time having finished, Snee moved down from beside Brutus into the crowd of pirates and grabbed a [[blaster rifle]], following Silvo as he was dragged up to the new captain. Brutus then declared that they would travel to At Attin, but that Silvo would still be executed if the world proved a disappointment. ===Invasion of At Attin=== [[File:Snee-ArrivalBridge-SC7.png|thumb|left|300px|Snobbius Snee (left) was speaking with Gunter on the bridge of the pirate frigate when it arrived at At Attin.]] When the frigate arrived above At Attin, Snee leaned against a console while talking to the pirate [[Gunter]] on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. As the world was surrounded by a [[Barrier]] that appeared to be a toxic maelstrom, Brutus quickly moved to execute Silvo; however, the former captain convinced the pirates that the treasure lay hidden behind the Barrier. After they captured the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'', a [[starship]] able to pass through the Barrier, Silvo killed Brutus and retook his place of captain.{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}} Silvo then traveled to the surface of At Attin on board the ''Onyx Cinder'' and forced [[Undersecretary]] [[Fara]] to allow the frigate through the Barrier and then contacted the bridge of the pirate ship via [[hologram]]. On the bridge, Snee stood beside Gunter, who had taken the captain's chair, as Silvo gave Gunter orders to bring the frigate down to At Attin's surface. Once in At Attin's [[atmosphere]], the frigate began [[Invasion of At Attin|firing]] on a [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|city]] and deployed drop-teams in [[Pirate dropship|dropships]]{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} {{AD|Disney+}} to round up its residents. ===Frigate's downfall=== {{Quote|Man your posts!|Gunter issuing orders that Snee ignores|audio=Gunter-ManYourPosts.flac|{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}}}} [[File:SneeFlees-SC8.png|thumb|right|300px|Snee fled from the bridge as the pirate frigate crashed to the surface of At Attin.]] During the invasion, Snee remained on the bridge with Gunter and watched as he gave the order to fire on the ''Onyx Cinder'', which was taking off from the [[city]] so that the At Attin resident [[KB]] could send a [[distress signal]] to the New Republic. Before the frigate could fire, KB's friend [[Neel]] fired a [[turbolaser]] from the city, destroying the frigate's main [[cannon]] and rocking the bridge, forcing Snee to steady themself to avoid falling over. KB succeeded in sending the signal, and, once Fara and her colleague [[Wendle]] brought down the Barrier entirely, a [[squadron]] of New Republic [[starfighter]]s arrived to confront the pirates. A pair of New Republic [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]]s then shot down the frigate. Snee ignored Gunter's orders for those on the bridge to remain at their posts and fled from the bridge as the ship slowly plummeted toward the city, where it crashed. ==Personality and traits== Snee had [[Color|brown]] skin and black [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Snee wore a black [[jacket]] lined with brown [[Hair|fur]] over a gray [[Clothing|shirt]] and black pants with a brown [[pauldron]] on their left shoulder. Gold chains and a red sash hung from the Keteerian's [[belt]], and in combat they used a machete and a [[blaster]] rifle. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|My character "Snobbius Snee" was known only by his nickname, "Batclam," while we were shooting Skeleton Crew. You can probably see where it comes from! Since he was one of the more prominent creatures that our tiny department dealt with, Andrea (who coined the nickname) and I turned it into a little patch as our department's crew gift, based on a Batman '66 style doodle I had done.|Jasper Anderson|{{Instagram|username=jasperjandersonfx|url=p/DFWG66Rs-GH|name=[[Jasper Anderson]]|date=2025-01-27|quote=My character "Snobbius Snee" was known only by his nickname, "Batclam," while we were shooting Skeleton Crew. You can probably see where it comes from! Since he was one of the more prominent creatures that our tiny department dealt with, Andrea (who coined the nickname) and I turned it into a little patch as our department's crew gift, based on a Batman '66 style doodle I had done.|archivefile=File:JasperAnderson-Batclam-Instagram.png}}}} [[File:Batclam-Instagram.png|thumb|right|300px|Snobbius Snee featured on the ''Skeleton Crew'' creatures team crew patch under his production name "Batclam."]] Snobbius Snee was voiced by [[John Hodgman]] and portrayed by performance artist [[Jasper Anderson]] in the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', first appearing in the first episode, "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]," which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}} The character's name was not spoken in the episode, but was listed in the credits. While playing the character, Anderson wore a muscle suit under the pirate costume and had an animatronic head that was puppeteered by [[Andrea Detwiler]],{{Instagram|username=jasperjandersonfx|url=p/DES6EswSpbl|name=[[Jasper Anderson]]|date=2025-01-01|quote=I'm in Star Wars! I got to spend some time on the other side of the camera as this pirate alien in Skeleton Crew! That's me under the animatronic head, muscle suit, and pirate costume. I spent about a week playing this character on the show, and it was some of the most fun I've had on set. The head was built by [[Neal Scanlan]]'s team for one of the previous movies, and was puppeteered on this show via radio control by [[Andrea Detwiler]]. I didn't know until the credits rolled that he's got an official Star Wars name, "Snobbius Snee," and that he's voiced by @johnhodgman!|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/efxHG|archivefile=File:JasperAnderson-SnobbiusSneeIG.jpg}} the show's specialty creature supervisor, via radio control. The head had been built by [[Neal Scanlan]]'s team for a previously released ''[[Star Wars]]'' film. [[Terrib Igmusk]]{{BucketsList|E_DxK2LQKFM|#1.14: "Dangerous Business"|sw_url=video/buckets-list-dangerous-business-star-wars-resistance}} from the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] is the only Keteerian character who appeared in a film prior to the release of the episode.{{Film|VIII}} Anderson spent about a week portraying the character but did not learn that Snee had been named until seeing the credits upon the show's release. During production, the character was known only as "Batclam," a nickname coined by Detwiler. Given the character's prominence, Anderson and Detwiler made a patch of Snee as their team's crew gift for the show based on a sketch Anderson made of the character referencing the logo of the 1966 [[Wikipedia:Batman (TV series)|''Batman'']] television series. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{1st}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}} *{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}} *{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Snobbius Snee|imagecat=Images of Snobbius Snee}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Snobbius Snee |ja=スノビウス・スニー |ka=სნობიუს სნი }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Keteerians]] [[Category:Members of Silvo's pirates]]
